```plato

//==
// # Unwelded face arrays
//
// Faces stored whole, with no index table and no vertex sharing: the form that
// comes out of CSG, marching cubes, tessellation, and STL import before a weld
// pass. The indexed counterparts are `TriangleMesh3D` / `QuadMesh3D`
// (declared above); representing unwelded geometry as one of those would need a
// 3n-entry identity index array, which wastes storage and falsely claims
// sharing.
//
// `Array` in the name is the invariant: immutable direct storage of whole faces.
// These types deliberately do NOT implement `IMeshElementCounts` — an unwelded
// array cannot dedupe undirected edges without building incidence, and
// `topology.concepts.plato` forbids guessing that count without building incidence.
// Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Winding, handedness, and normals.

// Independent triangles in space, each carrying its own three corner positions.
// IFace order is authored order; `ToTriangleMesh` welds nothing, it only supplies
// the identity index table.
type TriangleArray3D
    implements IValue, ITriangleGeometry3D
{
    Triangles: Array<Triangle3D>;
}
```
